name: Ant Design
summary: An enterprise-class UI design language and React UI library.

agent_entrypoints.what: Agent-oriented docs map covering components, the design language, and the token system. It links a full dump (llms-full.txt) that is ~2MB - reach for the semantic docs below instead of pulling it whole.

Ant Design's own design-language document: palette, tokens and values in the same shape as a DESIGN.md, written by the maintainers. Use it to theme an app to Ant Design rather than reverse-engineering the look.
Semantic component documentation (~750KB) covering component APIs precisely. Fetch it for API questions; too large to read whole.
Design-token based theming. Ant Design's tokens are the supported way to restyle it.

use_when: You are building an admin panel, console, or data-heavy internal tool.
You need forms and tables with serious built-in behaviour rather than primitives to assemble.
The product has a Chinese-market or enterprise audience where Ant Design is the familiar idiom.
You want Ant Design's own tokens and palette as a starting point - ant.design/design.md is a ready-made design-language document.
avoid_when: The surface is a marketing or consumer page - Ant Design is tuned for application chrome, not expressive layouts.
Bundle size on a small public site is a hard constraint.

baseline.description: An enterprise-class UI design language and React UI library
